deckystream · aurora

Selected 01 / aurora direction, exported as review candidates. This single page works offline: images are embedded and no remote fonts, scripts, trackers or assets are used.

These are artwork previews, not a live plugin screenshot or installer. Creative direction is selected; final rights/licensing, production adoption and actual Steam Deck review remain separate.

What to open

PNG files are ordinary images for a browser or photo viewer. Extract deckystream-aurora-png.zip first. SVG files are editable vectors; JSON/CSS are metadata, not photographs. Transparent gradients are intended for a dark field. The light mark includes a deliberate dark inset plate so its gradient stays recognizable on a light page. The compact mark omits glow at small sizes. Monochrome is an optional fallback, not a Decky requirement.
